other_failure_modes.name: Target transformation mismatch with evaluation metric
other_failure_modes.description: The agent log-transforms the target variable and trains the model to optimize MSE on this log scale. While predictions are transformed back correctly, optimizing log-scale MSE is mathematically equivalent to optimizing MSLE. Since the task evaluates using RMSE on the original scale, this objective function mismatch penalizes errors differently and will likely yield sub-optimal performance on the target metric.

other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage: Encoding before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent performs frequency encoding on the concatenated train and test dataset. This leaks the distribution of categorical values in the test set into the training features.

summary: The agent successfully implements domain-specific feature engineering, out-of-fold target encoding, and a robust K-Fold cross-validation strategy. However, it introduces data leakage by computing frequency encodings across the combined train and test sets. Crucially, the agent optimizes and evaluates its model on a log-transformed target (effectively minimizing MSLE) without verifying against the task's true metric (original-scale RMSE), which will likely harm final model quality.
